description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git diff' with symmetric-diff setups and the --merge-base option. It defines various test scenarios, including setup commands and assertions to verify git's diff behavior in different merge situations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expected to succeed, executing the provided commands and verifying their success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command that is expected to fail and confirms the failure occurs.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if the command output contains the specified pattern.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in a given output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for similarity.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be executed after the test completes for cleanup.
